newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Edison's Polymer Growth Fund cleared.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Edison's Polymer Growth Fund cleared.

text.p: Ohio Edison Co said Friday its Polymer Growth Fund was approved by the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio.

Participating polymer customers can receive a grant of up to 10 percent of their annual electricity payments for growth projects that meet technical and economic feasibility criteria, the utility said.
The program is designed to support polymer customers who have expertise, production processes and strong prospects for growth, but may be inhibited by capital constraints.

Ohio Edison said it will provide consulting services and financing assistance for a variety of production-related electrical equipment projects that will help improve the competitive position, employment opportunities, productivity and energy efficiency of polymer customers.
It said participating customers who receive electric service from Ohio Edison for at least five years after withdrawing funds will have no repayment obligation.

Typical electrotechnology projects that could receive funding include: adjustable speed drives, new injection mold machines and extruders, high-efficiency motors and air compressors and thermal insulating blankets.
